# Convergência Design System

> Canonical shared design library derived from SuperJarvis Convergência. Version 0.1.0. Portuguese documentation. Existing product adoption is deferred by the owner.

- Repository: https://github.com/xploryngDAO/convergencia-design-system
- Agent contract: https://github.com/xploryngDAO/convergencia-design-system/blob/v0.1.0/AGENTS.md
- Adoption: https://github.com/xploryngDAO/convergencia-design-system/blob/v0.1.0/docs/adoption.md
- Foundations: https://github.com/xploryngDAO/convergencia-design-system/blob/v0.1.0/docs/foundations.md
- Component registry: https://github.com/xploryngDAO/convergencia-design-system/blob/v0.1.0/component-registry.json
- Tokens: https://github.com/xploryngDAO/convergencia-design-system/blob/v0.1.0/tokens/tokens.json
- Interactive catalog: https://xploryngdao.github.io/convergencia-design-system/
- Machine-readable story index: https://xploryngdao.github.io/convergencia-design-system/index.json

Read the contract, choose a component, install a pinned release, import styles.css once, wrap with DesignSystemProvider, preserve domain behavior, and verify keyboard/mobile/dark-theme states. Never equate source CSS inventory with migrated products or backend functionality. Native export contains tokens, not React Native components.
